entities.name: Thalisse
entities.description: A human cleric from an unknown plane who woke in a graveyard with no memory and now spreads the stories of the dead.

events.summary: Thalisse wakes in a graveyard with no memory of who she is, surrounded by spirits.
events.quote: Thalisse woke up in a graveyard with no memory of who she was or how she got there.

events.summary: Having no story of her own, Thalisse decides to spread the tales of the dead.
events.quote: Thalisse decided to spread the tales of the dead who only wanted someone to listen.
